crypto/x509/name#

Distinguished names: the subject and issuer of a certificate, kept as their RDN groups in DER order.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

for certificate.subject().relative_names() -> group {
    for group.attributes() -> attribute { attribute.identifier(); attribute.value(); }
}

Description#

Distinguished names: the subject and issuer of a certificate, kept as their RDN groups in DER order.
